easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have at least one additional card in hand.
description:
Play Oboro.
When Oboro enters the battlefield, Kodama and Rydia trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's second ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rydia trigger, causing you to rummage.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Oboro from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro enters the battlefield, Rydia triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
